scenario: Sep 17: The National reported Sep 14 that Iran-Gulf talks were shelved because conditions were not right; no signed commercial reopening or verified route clearance is approved. Reviewed Brent is $105.12 (-0.67%) and WTI $101.55 (-0.86%) on Sep 17; JKM CFD is $27.23 (+8.00%) on Sep 16 and TTF is 77.58 EUR/MWh (-0.58%) on Sep 16. The official $22.00 Reuters September-delivery assessment remains carried. Reuters reported QatarEnergy is seeking 2-3 MTPA of US LNG through 2031 after Ras Laffan capacity was damaged; force majeure remains through November. Crisis level remains 4 (High); base 10%, stress 40%, tail 50%.
